changelog:
PerchTV can now keep itself up to date, and pairing codes grow to nine digits.

WHAT CHANGED

- PerchTV now checks for a new version on its own, about twice a day,
  and offers to download and install it on screen. Update now, or Later
  - Later declines only that version, never the next one. Downloads are
  checked against their published checksum before anything installs.
- Pairing codes are now nine digits, shown grouped in threes so they
  are easier to read across the room: 123 456 789. The QR code carries
  the same digits. During the changeover a six-digit code from before
  the change still works - the phone accepts both.

WHAT WAS FIXED

- A brief network hiccup could stop the stream and put up "The phone
  stopped the stream" when the phone had sent nothing at all. The
  television now keeps playing through a reconnect - the stream comes
  straight from the provider - and says "The pairing ended" only when a
  pairing actually ends.
